purpose: Teach: トレーディング/ファクト/定款/後部/圧巻/称する/用法/求職

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、トレーディング業務にもご興味を持たれたぞ
lines.en: When we were founding the company, your father showed real interest in the trading side of things.
lines.style: Warm nostalgic opening. Patient, deliberate pacing. Slight lift on the memory itself—not wistful, but genuinely fond. The tone of someone who has watched another person do something well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事実、つまりファクトを重視された
lines.en: Yes. He always prioritized facts—the reality of things.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Respectful nod in the voice. Steady tempo, no rush. A son confirming what his father already knows, without needing to elaborate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、定款の文言を自ら起草されたぞ
lines.en: He even drafted the articles of incorporation himself.
lines.style: Gentle marvel underneath. Slow, deliberate phrasing—each detail weighted. A trace of tenderness for the effort that detail required.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の後部までデザインにこだわった
lines.en: Yes. He was meticulous about the product design—every detail mattered to him.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself. Quiet admiration mixed with understanding the weight of that perfectionism. Slight pause before 'every detail,' as if remembering the care it took.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業記念パーティを圧巻のものにされたぞ
lines.en: He made the company's founding celebration truly spectacular.
lines.style: A glimpse of wonder—not performed, but genuine. Slow unfolding of the memory. Slight breath before the word 'spectacular,' as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新会社を「未来」と称する事を決められた
lines.en: Yes. He decided to name the company 'Mirai'—the future. That choice came from him.
lines.style: Contemplative. Small pause after the name, letting it settle. Quiet appreciation for the vision behind it. Even-paced, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品の用法を分かりやすく説明されたぞ
lines.en: He made sure the product's instructions were clear and easy to understand.
lines.style: Gentle recognition of a quiet virtue. Moderate pace. No performance—just an observation that lands softly. The voice of someone noticing kindness in detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは求職者にも丁寧に対応された
lines.en: Yes. He treated every job applicant with real care and respect.
lines.style: Grounded closing. Slight warmth on 'care and respect.' Even pacing, unrushed. The final word carries quiet weight—not eulogy, but genuine closure on a legacy of thoughtfulness.
